metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins for various integrations

plugins.name: discord-messaging
plugins.description: Discord REST API operations for messages, threads, and reactions

plugins.name: xcode-dev
plugins.description: Xcode build and test skills with XcodeBuildMCP support and xcodebuild fallback

plugins.name: auto-review
plugins.description: Parallel self-review with critical evaluation and auto-fix

plugins.name: article-quiz
plugins.description: Generate and grade comprehension quizzes from article URLs

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Karpathy提唱のLLM WikiパターンをObsidian Vault上に構築・維持するナレッジベーススキル

plugins.name: create-commit
plugins.description: Create Conventional Commits with configurable target (staged/all) and language (en/ja)

plugins.name: create-figure
plugins.description: Create figures and tables as HTML, render to PNG with headless Chrome, and trim to even margins

plugins.name: youtube-transcript
plugins.description: Fetch a YouTube video's transcript and write a Markdown file with summary, detailed explanation, and full transcript

plugins.name: apple-developer-video
plugins.description: Fetch an Apple Developer video session (WWDC/Tech Talks) page and write a Markdown file with summary, detailed explanation, and full official transcript
